array.string: export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.fsmonitor GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=false; C=__DEEPSEC_REPO__; G="$(dirname "$C")/.gitdirs/security-deepsec.git"; L="$C/.weekend-runner.lock"; page() { echo "[launchd] $(date -u +%FT%TZ) $1" >&2; E="$(dirname "$C")/.env"; U="$(sed -n 's/^PUSHOVER_USER=//p' "$E" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | tr -d "\"'")"; K="$(sed -n 's/^PUSHOVER_TOKEN=//p' "$E" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | tr -d "\"'")"; [ -n "$U" ] && [ -n "$K" ] && /usr/bin/curl -fsS -m 10 --form-string "token=$K" --form-string "user=$U" --form-string "title=radon security-deepsec: nightly did not start" --form-string "message=$1" https://api.pushover.net/1/messages.json >/dev/null 2>&1; return 0; }; P="$(cat "$C/.weekend-runner.lock/pid" 2>/dev/null)"; case "$P" in ""|*[!0-9]*|0|1) P= ;; esac; if [ -n "$P" ] && kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null; then S="$(cat "$L/start" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"; N="$(LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC /bin/ps -p "$P" -o lstart= 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"; O="$(/bin/ps -p "$P" -o lstart= 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"; if [ -z "$S" ] || [ -z "$N" ] || [ "$S" = "$N" ] || [ "$S" = "$O" ]; then page "skipped: pid $P still holds $L, so this scheduled cycle did not run"; exit 0; fi; fi; { T="$(command -v timeout || command -v gtimeout || true)"; [ -n "$T" ] || { page "no timeout or gtimeout on PATH; install coreutils"; exit 78; }; rm -f "$G/index.lock" "$G/HEAD.lock"; find "$G" \( -path "$G/objects" -o -path "$G/worktrees" \) -prune -o -type f -name "*.lock" -mmin +10 -exec rm -f {} + 2>/dev/null; F=1; for i in 1 2 3; do "$T" -k 15 180 git --git-dir="$G" --work-tree="$C" -c core.sshCommand="ssh -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=4" fetch -q origin && { F=0; break; }; [ "$i" = 3 ] || sleep "${RADON_LAUNCHD_FETCH_PAUSE_SECS:-30}"; done; [ "$F" = 0 ] && git --git-dir="$G" --work-tree="$C" checkout -f -q main && git --git-dir="$G" --work-tree="$C" reset --hard -q origin/main; } || { page "refresh of $C failed (fetch, checkout or reset); this cycle did not run"; exit 70; }; exec /bin/bash "$C/scripts/security_deepsec_nightly.sh" cycle
